=== database.yml.sample ===
default: &default
  adapter: postgresql
  encoding: unicode
  # For details on connection pooling, see Rails configuration guide
  # https://guides.rubyonrails.org/configuring.html#database-pooling
  pool: <%= ENV.fetch("RAILS_MAX_THREADS") { 5 } %>
  host: <%= ENV['APP_DB_HOST'] %>
  username: <%= ENV.fetch("APP_DB_USERNAME") { "samarbeid" } %>
  password: <%= ENV['APP_DB_PASSWORD'] %>
  database: <%= ENV.fetch("APP_DB_DATABASE") { "samarbeid_#{Rails.env}" } %>

development:
  <<: *default

test:
  <<: *default
  database: samarbeid_test

production:
  <<: *default
=== .yarnrc.yml ===
nodeLinker: node-modules

npmAuditIgnoreAdvisories: ["1111465", "1120679", "1120789", "1123525", "1124334", "1193728"]
# 1123525: CVE-2026-53571 (vite: `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff
#          Windows is not a supported platform for this project; this project runs on Linux; fix requires upgrading to vite@6.4.3+ (major version bump)
# 1111465: CVE-2025-8083 (Vuetify has a Prototype Pollution vulnerability), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3jp5-5f8r-q2wg
#          We need to upgrade to vuetify 3
# 1120679: GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (esbuild missing binary integrity verification via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr
#          Only exploitable when running esbuild via Deno; this project does not use Deno; this project uses esbuild via vite; a fix needs to upgrade to vite@8.x.x
# 1120789: GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff (vite server.fs.deny bypass via Windows alternate paths), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff
#          Windows-specific attack vector; this project runs on Linux; fix requires upgrading to vite@6.4.3+ (major version bump)
# 1124334: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg
#          No known exploit vector for this project; Also seems like incorrect audit data
# 1193728: GHSA-j95f-988m-3j2f (Tiptap quadratic ReDoS in block and inline Markdown attribute parsing), https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j95f-988m-3j2f
#          This project never parses Markdown with tiptap (HTML-only editor), so the vulnerable code path is unreachable, and a ReDoS here would only stall the attacker's own browser tab; a fix requires @tiptap/core >= 3.30.5, which tiptap-vuetify-custom pins to 3.22.3 and whose forked @tiptap/vue-2 is incompatible with

=== Procfile.dev ===
web: bin/rails s
vite: bin/vite dev
=== bin/dev ===
#!/usr/bin/env sh

if ! gem list foreman -i --silent; then
  echo "Installing foreman..."
  gem install foreman
fi

# Default to port 3000 if not specified
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"

# Let the debug gem allow remote connections,
# but avoid loading until `debugger` is called
export RUBY_DEBUG_OPEN="true"
export RUBY_DEBUG_LAZY="true"

exec foreman start -f Procfile.dev "$@"

=== bin/yarn ===
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
APP_ROOT = File.expand_path('..', __dir__)
Dir.chdir(APP_ROOT) do
  yarn = ENV["PATH"].split(File::PATH_SEPARATOR).
    select { |dir| File.expand_path(dir) != __dir__ }.
    product(["yarn", "yarn.cmd", "yarn.ps1"]).
    map { |dir, file| File.expand_path(file, dir) }.
    find { |file| File.executable?(file) }

  if yarn
    exec yarn, *ARGV
  else
    $stderr.puts "Yarn executable was not detected in the system."
    $stderr.puts "Download Yarn at https://yarnpkg.com/en/docs/install"
    exit 1
  end
end
=== Gemfile ===
source "https://rubygems.org"
git_source(:github) { |repo| "https://github.com/#{repo}.git" }

ruby file: ".ruby-version"

# Bundle edge Rails instead: gem 'rails', github: 'rails/rails'
gem "rails", "~> 8.1.0"
# Use PostgreSQL as the database for Active Record
gem "pg"
# Use Puma as the app server
gem "puma", "~> 7"
# Use SCSS for stylesheets
gem "sassc-rails"
gem "sprockets", "~> 4.0"

# Build JSON APIs with ease. Read more: https://github.com/rails/jbuilder
gem "jbuilder", "~> 2.5"

# HTML Abstraction Markup Language - A Markup Haiku
gem "haml", "~> 5.2.2" # Restricting to minor used previously (via rails_admin dependency)

# Use ActiveStorage variant
gem "image_processing", "~> 1.2"

gem "active_storage_validations"

# Reduces boot times through caching; required in config/boot.rb
gem "bootsnap", ">= 1.1.0", require: false

# Use Vite to manage app-like JavaScript modules in Rails
gem "vite_rails"

# Rails engine that provides an easy-to-use interface for managing your data
gem "rails_admin"

# Sentry Exception Tracking
gem "sentry-rails"

# Full-text search for Rails and PostgreSQL
gem "pg_search"

# A Scope & Engine based, clean, powerful, customizable and sophisticated paginator for Ruby webapps
gem "kaminari"

# AASM - State machines for Ruby classes (plain Ruby, ActiveRecord, Mongoid, NoBrainer)
gem "aasm"

# Multithreaded, Postgres-based, ActiveJob backend for Ruby on Rails.
gem "good_job"

# Flexible authentication solution for Rails with Warden.
gem "devise"
# Translations for the devise gem
gem "devise-i18n"
# The authorization Gem for Ruby on Rails.
gem "cancancan"

# Nokogiri (鋸) is a Rubygem providing HTML, XML, SAX, and Reader parsers with XPath and CSS selector support.
gem "nokogiri"

# This library is intended to provide Ruby with an interface for validating JSON objects against a JSON schema conforming to JSON Schema Draft 4
gem "json-schema"

gem "rails-i18n" # Centralization of locale data collection for Ruby on Rails

# Provides tooling to read and create RSS 0.91, 1.0, 2.0, and Atom feeds
gem "rss", require: false

# iCalendar is a Ruby library for dealing with iCalendar files in the iCalendar format defined by RFC-5545.
gem "icalendar"

# ice_cube is a ruby library for easily handling repeated events (schedules)
gem "ice_cube"

# Enummer implements multi-value enums with bitwise operations.
gem "enummer"

# Create ActiveRecord relations from UNIONs
gem "active_record-union_relation"

# Provides a library and registry for information about MIME content type definitions.
gem "mime-types"

group :development, :test do
  # Call 'binding.pry' anywhere in the code to stop execution and get a debugger console
  gem "awesome_print" # Pretty print your Ruby objects with style -- in full color and with proper indentation
  gem "pry-byebug" # Step-by-step debugging and stack navigation in Pry
  gem "pry-rails" # Rails >= 3 pry initializer
  gem "standard", require: false # Ruby Style Guide, with linter & automatic code fixer
  gem "stateoscope" # State Machine Visualizer - use like this: rake 'stateoscope:visualize[Workflow]'
  gem "knapsack" # Knapsack splits tests across CI nodes and makes sure that tests will run comparable time on each node.
end

group :development do
  # The Listen gem listens to file modifications and notifies you about the changes. Works everywhere!
  gem "listen"

  gem "web-console" # REPL console in the browser for Rails applications

  gem "rubycritic", require: false # A Ruby code quality reporter
end

group :test do
  # Adds support for Capybara system testing and selenium driver
  gem "capybara", ">= 2.15"
  gem "selenium-webdriver"
  gem "minitest-retry" # Re-run system test when the test fails.
  gem "capybara-lockstep" # Synchronize Capybara commands with application JavaScript and AJAX requests -> Avoids a lot of flaky tests

  # Group multiple assertions into one block to get results about all of them and not only the first failing. Inspired by rspec aggregate_failures. https://github.com/tjwp/aggregate_assertions
  gem "aggregate_assertions"

  # A gem providing "time travel", "time freezing", and "time acceleration" capabilities, making it simple to test time-dependent code.
  gem "timecop"

  gem "simplecov", "~> 0.20.0", require: false # Code Coverage Reports

  gem "roo" # For reading and comparing Excel files in Export tests

  gem "vcr"
  gem "webmock"
end

# Simple HTTP and REST client for Ruby, we use it to access Tika Text extraction service
gem "rest-client"

# NewRelic application performance monitoring
gem "newrelic_rpm"

# HTML-aware string truncation
gem "truncato", git: "https://github.com/Dietech-Group/truncato", branch: "frozen-string-literal"

# xlsx generation with charts, images, automated column width, customizable styles and full schema validation.
gem "caxlsx"

# external API
gem "grape", "~> 3.2"                     # Use Grape to build the API.
gem "grape-swagger"                       # provides an autogenerated documentation for your Grape API.
gem "grape-swagger-rails"                 # Swagger UI as Rails Engine for grape-swagger gem.
gem "grape-entity"                        # Grape's Entity is an API focused facade that sits on top of an object model.
gem "grape-swagger-entity"                # A simple grape-swagger adapter to allow parse representers as response model
gem "grape_logging"                       # Request logging for Grape!
# Pinned until grape-entity stops calling MultiJson.dump (legacy CamelCase API).
# multi_json 1.21 emits a deprecation warning for the legacy constant; grape-entity 1.0.4 still uses it.
gem "multi_json", "< 1.21"
gem "rack-cors"                           # support for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)

# A fast, pure-Ruby Markdown-superset converter"
gem "kramdown"
